title: Citation & directory outreach kit
lead: Submit consistent NAP (name, address, phone) to legitimate directories. Use the templates below - never spam, never buy fake DA80 links.

directories.name: Google Business Profile
directories.napFields: Name, address, phone, hours, categories, photos
directories.notes: Primary local ranking signal. Keep hours and categories exact.

directories.name: Apple Business Connect
directories.notes: Important for Apple Maps and Siri.

directories.name: Justdial
directories.notes: Strong India local citation. Match GMB category closely.

directories.name: Clutch
directories.notes: High-trust agency listing. Collect client reviews.

directories.name: Capterra (if SaaS product)
directories.notes: Only if you have a software product.

directories.name: Yelp
directories.notes: Claim and close if not relevant for your market.

directories.name: Better Business Bureau (if US clients)
directories.notes: Skip unless you serve US customers.

directories.name: India Yellow Pages / regional dirs
directories.notes: Pick 2-3 quality regional dirs; skip spam farms.

directories.name: Local chamber of commerce / association
directories.notes: Industry associations often give dofollow member pages.

templates.name: Resource / tool mention outreach
templates.subject: Free {{tool_name}} for your {{audience}} readers
templates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I noticed your guide on {{their_topic}} at {{their_url}}.

We published a free {{tool_name}} that helps Indian businesses {{benefit}}:
{{tool_url}}

If it is useful for your readers, feel free to mention or link it. No payment or obligation - just a practical resource.

Happy to share a short blurb or screenshot if helpful.

Best,
{{your_name}}
DisplayAvenue

templates.subject: Data point from India SME Digital Growth Report 2026
templates.body:

I am sharing our India SME Digital Growth Report 2026 - benchmarks on Google / Instagram / WhatsApp enquiry mix for Indian SMEs:

{{report_url}}

You are welcome to cite any chart or stat with attribution. If you publish a roundup or newsletter, I can send a quote or graphic.

Thanks,
{{your_name}}
